; PROBE (temporary): does requestSleep() escalate LightSleep -> DeepSleep cleanly?
; Orchestrated: temporarily set lightSleepEnabled=true + idleSuspendDelay=60s, wait for
; the device to idle into LightSleep(1), then wait 4s (EPD settles on the frozen screen),
; call requestSleep(), log every displayState transition, restore the original settings.
; Failsafe restore after 30 min if light sleep never happens. Removed after journal read.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: escalationProbe
				visible: false

				property bool origLight: false
				property double origIdle: 300000
				property int phase: 0 // 0 armed-pending, 1 waiting-for-light, 2 escalated, 3 restored

				function restoreSettings(reason) {
					if (phase >= 3) return;
					Settings.lightSleepEnabled = origLight;
					Settings.idleSuspendDelay = origIdle;
					phase = 3;
					console.log("ESCTEST restored settings (" + reason + "): lightSleepEnabled="
						+ Settings.lightSleepEnabled + " idleSuspendDelay=" + Settings.idleSuspendDelay);
				}

				Timer { // arm
					interval: 5000
					running: true
					onTriggered: {
						escalationProbe.origLight = Settings.lightSleepEnabled;
						escalationProbe.origIdle = Settings.idleSuspendDelay;
						Settings.lightSleepEnabled = true;
						Settings.idleSuspendDelay = 60000;
						escalationProbe.phase = 1;
						console.log("ESCTEST armed: lightSleepEnabled=" + Settings.lightSleepEnabled
							+ " idleSuspendDelay=" + Settings.idleSuspendDelay
							+ " (orig " + escalationProbe.origLight + "/" + escalationProbe.origIdle + ")"
							+ " state=" + BatteryManager.displayState);
					}
				}

				Timer {
					id: escalateTimer
					interval: 4000
					onTriggered: {
						console.log("ESCTEST escalating: requestSleep() from state="
							+ BatteryManager.displayState + " t=" + Date.now());
						escalationProbe.phase = 2;
						try { BatteryManager.requestSleep(); } catch (e) {
							console.log("ESCTEST requestSleep threw: " + e);
						}
						restoreTimer.restart();
					}
				}

				Timer {
					id: restoreTimer
					interval: 6000
					onTriggered: escalationProbe.restoreSettings("post-escalation")
				}

				Timer { // failsafe
					interval: 1800000
					running: true
					onTriggered: escalationProbe.restoreSettings("failsafe timeout")
				}

				Connections {
					target: BatteryManager
					ignoreUnknownSignals: true
					function onDisplayStateChanged(previous, next) {
						console.log("ESCTEST displayState " + previous + " -> " + next + " t=" + Date.now());
						if (escalationProbe.phase === 1 && next === BatteryManager.LightSleep)
							escalateTimer.restart();
					}
					function onSuspending() { console.log("ESCTEST suspending t=" + Date.now()); }
					function onWokeUp() { console.log("ESCTEST wokeUp t=" + Date.now()); }
					function onResumed() { console.log("ESCTEST resumed t=" + Date.now()); }
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
